name: Albiano (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Albiano (a tree on blue and white) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI ALBIANO in black beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Albiano, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Albiano arms — tree on blue and white, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI ALBIANO beneath the arms
